IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair falls past her shoulders and wears layered
silver necklaces. She wears a lilac long-sleeve
mesh top with a scoop neckline, a sheer
lace-trimmed bodice with small floral embroidery,
and a center zip. A wide embellished metal belt sits
low over dark flare jeans. Pointed silver-toned
shoes complete the look. Her expression is calm
and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of lilac,
charcoal denim, and silver. Playful and delicate, in
the style of a Y2K lookbook.
